subject: Trading
title: Michael Burry: The Big Short
description: Learn Michael Burry: The Big Short in one minute.

hook.text: Michael Burry saw the 2008 housing crash coming years early. He bet against subprime mortgages and made $700 million.

buildup.text: A doctor turned investor, Burry analyzed individual mortgage loan data and realized default rates would skyrocket.

discovery.text: He bought credit default swaps on subprime mortgage bonds—effectively insurance that paid out when the bonds failed.

twist.text: For two years, he was wrong on timing. Investors demanded their money back. He locked them in and endured their rage.

climax.text: When the housing market collapsed in 2008, his bets paid off. Being early felt like being wrong—until it wasn't.

punchline.text: He was right, early, and hated for it—until the crash proved him a genius.

quiz.question: What was the biggest challenge Burry faced with his housing bet?
options: He couldn't find the right instrument
He was early by two years and investors wanted out before the payoff
